6.360 rsInvalidSelfJoinRelationship
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsNonExistingRelationshipRelatedScope is a critical error that will occur when a DataSet specifies a
DefaultRelationship for a RelatedDataSet where Dataset.Name is equal to RelatedDataSet.
